kill_criteria: K1: spent 1.5x target CPL (> 90 EGP) with zero leads → stop the ad
K2: CTR < 0.5% after 2,500 impressions → kill the creative
K3: CPM > 200 EGP for 3 days → widen the audience or stop
K4: frequency > 3.5 within the week → refresh
K5: zero leads after 1,500 link clicks → the landing page is the problem, not the ad
